Levels of expressed genes mapped onto the KEGG pathway module

Levels of expressed genes mapped onto the KEGG pathway module. (A) Motor proteins. (B) Calcium signaling pathway. The expression levels of genes for the six groups are shown in each gene box. The gene box colors indicate low (green) and high (red) expression. Undetected genes are shown in white
